description: Create a named ticker list owned by your account.

description.description: Free-form notes, up to 500 characters. Stored as `""` when omitted.

id.description: Optional slug — becomes the universe's permanent handle everywhere (`?universe=`, subscribe `universe`, CRUD path). Pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$` — starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters/digits/underscore, 63 chars max; the value is trimmed and lowercased before validation. `top_10` and `top_100` are reserved for system universes and rejected with 400. Must be unique within your account. Generated (`u_…`) if omitted.

name.description: Human-readable label, up to 80 characters. Display-only — never used to reference the universe.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols, up to 10,000. Validated against the active universe. `[]` is accepted — a shell universe you can fill later via PATCH.

name: tickerbot_create_universe
